title: ValidationContract
description: A finite checklist of testable behavioral assertions defining done/correct, written BEFORE the design defines its approach so success criteria are not biased by the planned implementation (Factory.ai two-level TDD pattern).

outcome.description: Must be 'contract_complete' when the contract is fully specified

assertions.description: Each assertion is a single testable behavioral statement the implementation must satisfy

assertion.description: One observable, testable behavior — not an implementation detail

verify.description: How to check it: a test name, command, or observable outcome

notes.description: Scope boundaries, explicit non-goals, open risks
